<!---
## What this file does

Stage 04 owns the ROLLUP METRICS. It loads the resolved, unified data that 03
produced (double-bookings already resolved), builds the class/teacher/student
rollups that feed VISTA, proves they're export-ready, and writes them to
SharePoint as .xlsx.

03 resolves. 04 rolls up. 04 does NOT re-run the resolution engine — it trusts
03's output, so the two never drift.
--->

```{r setup-libraries}
rm(list = ls())
library(gt); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(glue)
library(yaml); library(Microsoft365R); library(erstools); library(openxlsx)
```

```{r setup-helpers}
# 04 needs only the rollup layer + add-ons (+ review for the checks). No engine.
h <- here::here("templates", "course_schedule", "helpers")
for (f in c("01_cs_review_helpers.R","02_cs_expression_helpers.R",
            "04_cs_rollup_helpers.R","04_cs_addon_teacher_hr.R","04_cs_addon_course_grades.R"))
  source(file.path(h, f))
```

```{r setup-config-and-data}
config <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here("config","districts","cs_nashville.yaml"))
spec   <- expr_spec(config)

orgfiles_site <- get_sharepoint_site(site_url = "https://erstrategies1.sharepoint.com/sites/orgfiles")

# 03's output: the resolved, unified frame (double-bookings already resolved)
unified <- tr_safe(ers_read_sharepoint(
  folder_path = config$raw_data_folder_path,
  file_name_with_extension = "/2. Processed Data/03_cs_data_post_unification.csv"), NULL)
```

```{r rollup-layer}
# ---- core rollup layer (Tier 1 + Tier 2), in dependency order ----
unified <- add_minutes(unified, config, spec)
unified <- add_class_size(unified, config)
unified <- add_class_primaries(unified)
unified <- add_class_fields(unified)
unified <- add_class_demographics(unified)
unified <- add_class_weight_times_size(unified)
unified <- add_teacher_metrics(unified, config)
unified <- add_teacher_primary_fields(unified)
unified <- add_teacher_el_swd(unified)
unified <- add_teacher_flags(unified)
```

```{r add-ons}
# ---- optional add-ons (Tier 3), only if enabled in config$add_ons ----
hr_on     <- isTRUE(config$add_ons$teacher_hr$enabled)
grades_on <- isTRUE(config$add_ons$course_grades$enabled)
grades_rollup <- NULL

if (hr_on) {
  hr_data <- tr_safe(ers_read_sharepoint(config$raw_data_folder_path,
               config$add_ons$teacher_hr$file), NULL)
  if (!is.null(hr_data)) unified <- apply_teacher_hr(unified, hr_data, config)
}

if (grades_on) {
  grades_raw    <- tr_safe(ers_read_sharepoint(config$raw_data_folder_path,
                     config$add_ons$course_grades$file), NULL)
  course_coding <- tr_safe(ers_read_sharepoint(config$raw_data_folder_path,
                     config$raw_files$course_coding), NULL)
  if (!is.null(grades_raw) && !is.null(course_coding)) {
    gr <- process_course_grades(grades_raw, course_coding, config)
    unified <- apply_course_grades(unified, gr$student_proficiency)
    grades_rollup <- gr$course_grades_rollup
  }
}
```

```{r build-rollups}
teacher_rollup <- build_teacher_rollup(unified, config)
class_rollup   <- build_class_rollup(unified, teacher_rollup, config)
student_rollup <- build_student_rollup(unified, config)
```

```{r precompute-checks}
# 4.2 class-size hook: adjusted size never exceeds raw headcount
size_invariant <- tr_safe(all(class_rollup$M_cls_class_size <= class_rollup$M_cls_num_stu + 1e-9, na.rm=TRUE), FALSE)

# 4.3 buckets populated for INCLUDED classes / teachers
cls_bucket_na <- tr_safe(class_rollup |> filter(C_class_size_exclude == "Include") |>
  summarise(n = sum(is.na(C_cls_class_size_bucket))) |> pull(n), NA)
tch_bucket_na <- tr_safe(teacher_rollup |> summarise(n = sum(is.na(M_tch_load_bucket))) |> pull(n), NA)
bucket_levels <- tr_safe(levels(.bucketize(0, config$buckets$class_size)), character(0))

# 4.4 teacher utilization populated
util_na <- tr_safe(teacher_rollup |> summarise(n = sum(is.na(M_tch_utilization))) |> pull(n), NA)

# 4.5 column contract — expected VISTA columns present in each rollup
want_class <- c("C_class_id","C_cls_course_subject","C_cls_grade","C_cls_course_name",
                "M_cls_class_size","C_cls_class_size_bucket","M_cls_class_weight","M_meeting_minutes",
                "M_tch_utilization","M_tch_load")
want_tch   <- c("D_employee_id","C_tch_course_subject","C_tch_location_name",
                "M_tch_num_periods","M_tch_utilization","M_tch_load","M_tch_load_bucket","M_tch_num_preps")
want_stu   <- c("D_stu_id","C_class_id","C_course_subject","M_class_weight",
                "M_cls_class_size","C_proficiency")
miss_class <- setdiff(want_class, names(class_rollup))
miss_tch   <- setdiff(want_tch,   names(teacher_rollup))
miss_stu   <- setdiff(want_stu,   names(student_rollup))
contract_ok <- length(miss_class)==0 && length(miss_tch)==0 && length(miss_stu)==0

bucket_levels <- tr_safe(levels(.bucketize(0, config$buckets$class_size)), character(0))

# 4.2 class size distribution by school 
dist_by_school <- tr_safe(
  class_rollup |>
    filter(C_class_size_exclude == "Include") |>
    group_by(C_cls_location_name, C_class_id) |>
    summarise(bucket = C_cls_class_size_bucket[which.max(M_cls_class_size)], .groups = "drop") |>
    count(C_cls_location_name, bucket) |>
    group_by(C_cls_location_name) |>
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
    ungroup() |> select(-n) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = bucket, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0, names_expand = TRUE) |>
    select(C_cls_location_name, any_of(bucket_levels)) |>
    rename(School = C_cls_location_name),
  data.frame())

```

## 04 — Rollups & export-readiness

```{r stage04}
#| results: 'asis'
s04 <- tr_stage(
  number = "04", title = "Rollups & Export Readiness",
  question = "Are the class, teacher, and student rollups built correctly and ready for VISTA?",
  checks = list(

    tr_check("4.1", "Rollups built — shapes look right",
      good = "One row per class-slot, per teacher, and per student-class-slot.",
      status = "none",
      evidence = function() data.frame(
        rollup = c("class","teacher","student", if (!is.null(grades_rollup)) "course_grades"),
        rows   = c(nrow(class_rollup), nrow(teacher_rollup), nrow(student_rollup),
                   if (!is.null(grades_rollup)) nrow(grades_rollup)),
        cols   = c(ncol(class_rollup), ncol(teacher_rollup), ncol(student_rollup),
                   if (!is.null(grades_rollup)) ncol(grades_rollup)))),

    tr_check("4.2", "Class size — distribution by school (% of classes per size band)",
      good = "Adjusted size never exceeds raw headcount; the table shows the share of classes in each size band, by school.",
      value  = if (size_invariant) "PASS — adjusted \u2264 raw headcount" else "FAIL — an adjusted size exceeds raw headcount",
      status = if (size_invariant) "ok" else "flag",
      evidence = function() list(
        "Class-size distribution — % of classes per bucket, by school" = dist_by_school,
        "Adjusted vs raw headcount" = class_rollup |>
          summarise(classes = n_distinct(C_class_id),
                    avg_raw_headcount = round(mean(M_cls_num_stu, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                    avg_adjusted_size = round(mean(M_cls_class_size, na.rm = TRUE), 1)))),

    tr_check("4.3", "Class-size & teacher-load buckets populated",
      good = "Every included class has a size bucket; every teacher has a load bucket (config buckets cover the data).",
      value  = if (isTRUE(cls_bucket_na==0 && tch_bucket_na==0)) "PASS"
               else glue("FAIL — {cls_bucket_na} class + {tch_bucket_na} teacher NA buckets"),
      status = if (isTRUE(cls_bucket_na==0 && tch_bucket_na==0)) "ok" else "flag",
      evidence = function() data.frame(check = c("class-size NA buckets","teacher-load NA buckets"),
                                       n = c(cls_bucket_na, tch_bucket_na),
                                       note = c("If > 0: a class size falls outside rollup_buckets.class_size — extend the top bucket.",
                                                "If > 0: a teacher load falls outside rollup_buckets.teacher_load."))),

    tr_check("4.4", "Teacher utilization populated",
      good = "Every teacher has a utilization value (periods_per_school covers every school in the data).",
      value  = if (isTRUE(util_na==0)) "PASS" else glue("FAIL — {util_na} teachers with NA utilization"),
      status = if (isTRUE(util_na==0)) "ok" else "flag",
      evidence = function() list("If this FAILS" = data.frame(check =
        "A school in the data has no periods_per_school entry (exact name match). Confirm config$periods_per_school keys match unique(C_tch_location_name)."),
        "Utilization spread" = teacher_rollup |> group_by(C_tch_location_name) |>
          summarise(teachers = n(), avg_util = round(mean(M_tch_utilization, na.rm=TRUE),2),
                    na = sum(is.na(M_tch_utilization)), .groups="drop"))),

    tr_check("4.5", "VISTA column contract",
      good = "Each rollup has the columns VISTA expects (add-on fields present even when NA).",
      value  = if (contract_ok) "PASS — all expected columns present"
               else glue("FAIL — missing: {paste(c(miss_class, miss_tch, miss_stu), collapse=', ')}"),
      status = if (contract_ok) "ok" else "flag",
      evidence = function() data.frame(
        rollup  = c("class","teacher","student"),
        missing = c(ifelse(length(miss_class)==0,"none",paste(miss_class,collapse=", ")),
                    ifelse(length(miss_tch)==0,"none",paste(miss_tch,collapse=", ")),
                    ifelse(length(miss_stu)==0,"none",paste(miss_stu,collapse=", "))))),

    tr_check("4.6", "Add-on status",
      good = "The optional add-ons ran (or were correctly skipped) based on config$add_ons.",
      status = "none",
      evidence = function() data.frame(
        add_on = c("teacher_hr","course_grades"),
        enabled = c(hr_on, grades_on),
        mode = c(tr_safe(config$add_ons$teacher_hr$mode, NA), "—"),
        result = c(if (hr_on && "C_tch_novice_indicator" %in% names(teacher_rollup)) "novice indicator populated" else "skipped / NA",
                   if (!is.null(grades_rollup)) glue("{nrow(grades_rollup)} grade rows; proficiency merged") else "skipped / NA")))
  )
)
htmltools::browsable(render_stage(s04))
```

## Export

```{r export}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
out_folder <- config$raw_data_folder_path
put <- function(data, name)
  ers_write_sharepoint(data = data, folder_path = out_folder,
                       file_name_with_extension = paste0("/2. Processed Data/", name, ".xlsx"))

put(class_rollup,   "04_class_rollup")
put(teacher_rollup, "04_teacher_rollup")
put(student_rollup, "04_student_rollup")
if (!is.null(grades_rollup)) put(grades_rollup, "04_course_grades_rollup")
```
